claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.harm: The fuzz harness aborts on random input due to libsecp256k1 illegal argument assertions when passing never-generated secnonces, breaking oss-fuzz runs
claims.quote: The target aborts on 8 of 1000 files, with `[libsecp256k1] illegal argument: secp256k1_memcmp_var(&secnonce->data[0], secp256k1_musig_secnonce_magic, 4) == 0`.

status_by.quote: Yes, I think this is a better approach. I've dropped that call from this harness.

claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.harm: Multi-participant signing and signature aggregation paths are virtually unreachable when feeding arbitrary random bytes as nonce points
claims.quote: These bytes are almost never a valid pair of nonce points, so a session with more than one participant almost always stops before signing.

status_by.quote: Ahh, makes sense, thanks! I think I've understood and taken your suggestions.
